title_o: A single-system account of the relationship between priming, recognition, and fluency.
verdict_reason: The audit script reads Agg_priming_ANOVA.dat (OSF guid btr65, in the Data child) and runs a paired t-test of meanRT_cr vs meanRT_miss; both columns are present for all 32 participants and the recomputation gives p=.0227, d=.424, matching the table.

data_files.notes: tab-delimited, UTF-8 BOM, CRLF; per-participant mean RTs for hit/cr/fa/miss; meanRT_fa has 2 NA (not used by key test). The file the audit script loads.
SPSS twin of the .dat, not opened
trial-level raw data, 32 unique vpnum; aggregation to the .dat file is not scripted anywhere on the node
headers only checked; decimal commas in some of these files (not the key-test file)

key_test.test: two-sided paired t-test, RT to correct rejections vs RT to misses; d = t/sqrt(n) via compute.es::des

recompute.method: python recomputation (scipy) and base R t.test on the downloaded file

obstacles: key-test file is participant-level aggregate; the trial-to-aggregate step is not scripted (raw trials are present in Analysedaten_1.sav)
audit script needs httr/RCurl/compute.es and a remote helper from sachaepskamp.com; ran the test with base R instead
